mechanism_narrative: Persistent federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate regimes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with strong housing demand (HOUST > 1500) generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 1500, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
